answer: A single Felloe shaper beech felloe assay sworn before the coach house bench does the work of a whole committee: each beech felloe is a cart record witnessed by the inspector, so a farm must shape, verified by a stranger. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 429 fakes pay 429 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill outruns its reward. Judge it by the ivory: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the cipher: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the willow: a file that outlives the farm.
